name: io.github.github/github-mcp-server
title: GitHub
description: Work with repositories, issues, pull requests and code on GitHub.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Authorization header with authentication token (PAT or App token)

com.linjiejim.greenhouse/connector.description_zh: 操作 GitHub 上的仓库、issue、PR 和代码——用每位成员自己的访问令牌。

auth.help: A GitHub personal access token (fine-grained recommended) with access to the repositories you want the agent to use.
auth.help_zh: 一个 GitHub 个人访问令牌（推荐 fine-grained），授予你希望 Agent 使用的仓库权限。

verification.notes: GitHub's OAuth has neither dynamic registration nor client-id metadata documents, so the zero-setup path is each member's own PAT. A team can instead register its own OAuth app and switch the connector to OAuth with that client id.
